about.title: About Us
about.metaDescription: Learn about our mission to bring safe, inspiring, multilingual moral and folktales to readers, families, and classrooms worldwide.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.content: Daily Tale was born from a timeless truth: stories shape character, awaken empathy, and build bridges across cultures. In an internet overflowing with noisy feeds, distracting ads, and dopamine loops, we offer a peaceful sanctuary—a place where readers, families, teachers, and language learners everywhere can gather daily for wisdom, wonder, and gentle reading.

sections.heading: Ten Equal World Languages
sections.content: Daily Tale is a global, multilingual library celebrating ten world languages equally: English, Tamil, Hindi, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified), Portuguese, Malayalam, Telugu, Kannada, and Marathi. Every language is treated with equal care, natural vocabulary, and cultural respect.

sections.heading: Our Sacred Promise: Safe, Calm & Ad-Free
sections.content:
We make four unwavering commitments to every reader, parent, and teacher:
1. 100% Safe & Respectful: Every single story is vetted by editors. No graphic violence, no gore, and strictly no mature adult themes.
2. No Manipulative Engagement: We do not use casino streaks, shaming notifications, autoplay chains, or hidden tracking.
3. Zero Child Data Profiling: Readers never need an account. Reading progress, favorites, and badges remain strictly on your local device.
4. Educational Depth: Stories are paired with Bloom's taxonomy discussion cards, vocabulary pronunciation, and creative activities.

sections.heading: How Stories are Chosen and Retold
sections.content: We curate timeless public-domain fables, folklore, and cultural legends from ancient traditions (Panchatantra, Aesop, Jataka, Andersen, Grimm, Arabian Nights, Latin American folklore, and African lore). Traditional narratives are retold with cultural nuance, removing historical cruelty while preserving their core moral truth and wonder.

sections.heading: Human-in-the-Loop Linguistic Review
sections.content: To bring stories to ten languages, we leverage advanced linguistic AI models to draft meaning-based translations that preserve regional idioms. However, machine output is never final. Every translation is placed behind a strict quarantine and is made public and indexable only after human linguistic and pedagogical review.

sections.heading: Cultural Credits & Origin Notes
sections.content: We honour the collective human heritage of world folklore. Retellings derive from verified public domain sources, historical folk anthologies, and credited community contributions. We celebrate the oral storytellers of every continent who kept these fires burning across generations.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.metaDescription: Educational and literary disclaimer regarding retold folklore, cultural parables, and linguistic translations.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose of the Platform
sections.content: All stories, quizzes, moral summaries, and learning activities provided on Daily Tale are intended strictly for educational, ethical, and literary enjoyment. They do not constitute professional, legal, medical, or psychological advice.

sections.heading: 2. Folklore Retelling & Cultural Parables
sections.content: Stories originating from ancient lore, fables, and folk traditions are presented purely as cultural heritage and literary parables. To maintain a peaceful, universal, and non-sectarian environment accessible to families and readers of all faiths and beliefs worldwide, narratives focus on universal human values such as honesty, courage, empathy, and wisdom.

sections.heading: 3. Translations
sections.content: Multilingual translations are prepared with the assistance of advanced language models and reviewed by human linguists. While we strive for absolute linguistic elegance, nuances may occasionally differ. Readers are encouraged to reach out to suggest phrase refinements.

sections.heading: 4. Reader Submissions
sections.content: Original tales submitted by community members and published after moderation reflect the creative imagination of their respective authors, not the official stance of Daily Tale.

sections.heading: 5. Family & Educator Guidance
sections.content: While our editorial board strictly enforces family-safe ratings and community standards, parents and educators remain the ultimate guides of suitability for individual young readers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Plain-language, cookie-free privacy policy adhering to COPPA, GDPR, and global data protection laws. We protect readers by collecting zero unnecessary data.
privacy.summary: Plain Language Summary: We believe reading should be completely private. We do not require accounts, we do not track reading behavior across the web, we use zero third-party advertising trackers, and we never sell data. Your favorites and reading progress stay exclusively inside your own device's browser memory.

sections.heading: 1. What We Collect and Why
sections.content:
Because we operate without user logins for readers, we collect virtually no personal information:
• On-Device Data (localStorage): Your reading history, bookmarked favorites, and audio preferences remain strictly in your browser's local memory. We never transmit or store this on our servers.
• Daily Story Email Subscribers (Adults Only): When an adult subscribes to our daily story email, we store their email address and language preference securely. This requires explicit confirmation.
• Community Story Submissions: When a writer submits a story, we collect the submitted text, pen name, and contact email solely for editorial communication and attribution.
• Privacy-Friendly Aggregated Metrics: We log anonymous counts of page reads to understand which stories readers love. We do NOT log IP addresses, fingerprint devices, or run invasive tracking scripts.

sections.heading: 2. Reader Protection (COPPA & Global Standards)
sections.content:
We comply strictly with international child protection and data privacy standards:
• No personal data is knowingly requested or collected from children.
• Newsletter signups and contact forms are intended strictly for adults and guardians.
• If we learn that personal data of a minor has been unintentionally submitted, we purge it immediately.

sections.heading: 3. No Advertising & No Data Selling
sections.content: We do not sell, rent, monetize, or disclose user information to data brokers, ad networks, or commercial third parties under any circumstances.

sections.heading: 4. Your Rights & Data Deletion
sections.content: You have the right to request access, correction, or permanent erasure of any contact details or subscriber records associated with your email. You may contact support@dailystory.pages.dev at any time.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.metaDescription: Terms of service governing reading, fair classroom use, community story submissions, and intellectual property rights.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using Daily Tale, you agree to these Terms of Use and our community guidelines. If you are accessing this platform on behalf of a minor, you represent that you are their parent, guardian, or authorized educator.

sections.heading: 2. Permitted Educational & Personal Use
sections.content: You are warmly welcome to read, listen to, and share these stories at home and in school classrooms. Teachers and educators are explicitly permitted to project stories and print worksheets for non-commercial educational use.

sections.heading: 3. Restrictions: No Scraping or Bulk Copying
sections.content: You may not systematically scrape, harvest, reproduce in bulk, mirror, or ingest our stories, translations, audio, or quizzes into automated commercial databases or competing services without prior written permission.

sections.heading: 4. Community Submission License
sections.content: When you submit an original story, you retain full copyright ownership of your work. By submitting, you grant Daily Tale a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to format, translate, and publish the story on our platform with credit to your pen name.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Daily Tale is provided on an 'as-is' and 'as-available' basis without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for incidental or consequential damages resulting from platform use.

cookies.title: Cookie & Local Storage Notice
cookies.metaDescription: Detailed disclosure of the zero-cookie policy and device local storage keys used to save reading progress and themes.

sections.heading: Our Zero-Tracking Cookie Policy
sections.content: Daily Tale does not use third-party tracking cookies, advertising beacons, or cross-site fingerprinting scripts.

sections.heading: What We Store in Your Device's LocalStorage
sections.content:
To provide a delightful reading experience without requiring user accounts, the following lightweight keys are stored exclusively on your device:
• `dailytale_lang`: Your preferred reading language (e.g. 'en', 'ta', 'es').
• `dailytale_favorites`: The IDs of stories you have bookmarked.
• `dailytale_recent`: The stories you recently read, allowing quick resumption.
• `dailytale_theme`: Your dark/bedtime/sepia visual theme preference.
• `dailytale_fontSize` & `dailytale_fontFamily`: Reading typography preferences.

sections.heading: How to Clear Your Storage
sections.content: Because these keys reside on your own computer, tablet, or phone, you can clear them at any time using your browser's 'Clear Site Data' or 'Clear Cookies and Site Storage' settings.

copyright.title: Copyright & Takedown Policy
copyright.metaDescription: Notice of public domain sources, educational fair use, and our rapid 24-hour copyright review procedure.

sections.heading: Public Domain and Proprietary Content
sections.content: Traditional folktales and fables on this platform are drawn from public-domain folklore. Original retellings, translations, pedagogical quizzes, discussion cards, custom artwork, logos, and UI code are the exclusive intellectual property of Daily Tale.

sections.heading: Notice and Takedown Procedure
sections.content:
If you are a copyright owner or authorized agent and believe that content published on our platform infringes upon your copyright, please submit a written notice to support@dailystory.pages.dev including:
1. Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed.
2. The exact URL of the material on our platform.
3. Your contact address, phone number, and email.
4. A statement of good faith belief that the use is unauthorized.
5. A statement made under penalty of perjury that you are authorized to act.

sections.heading: Resolution Timeline
sections.content: Upon receipt of a valid notice, our team will review the claim, temporarily restrict access if warranted, and respond within 24 to 48 hours.

guidelines.title: Community & Submission Guidelines
guidelines.h1: Community Guidelines for Readers and Storytellers
guidelines.metaDescription: Submission guidelines for community stories: family-safe standards, original storytelling, wholesome humor, and moderation rules.

sections.heading: What We Welcome with Open Arms
sections.content:
• Original folktales, humorous tales, moral parables, and gentle bedtime stories.
• Stories celebrating kindness, honesty, perseverance, courage, and empathy.
• Tales rooted in authentic regional cultures, legends, and everyday life.
• Wholesome humor that brings families together in shared laughter.

sections.heading: What is Strictly Prohibited
sections.content:
• Any 18+, adult, or suggestive themes.
• Graphic violence, gore, terror, or intense nightmares.
• Hate speech, prejudice, or mockery of any ethnicity, nationality, or community.
• Religious proselytization, sectarian disputes, or theological debates.
• Commercial promotions, spam, or plagiarism.

sections.heading: Moderation Process
sections.content: All community submissions are automatically scanned and reviewed manually by our editorial team before publication. Approved stories appear with the author's pen name and country.

editorial-policy.title: Editorial & AI-Use Policy
editorial-policy.metaDescription: Our pedagogical principles, folklore adaptation standards, human-reviewed translations, and transparent corrections policy.

sections.heading: 1. Pedagogical Framing with Bloom's Taxonomy
sections.content: Stories are doorways to thoughtful reflection. Stories are paired with discussion questions tiered by Bloom's Revised Taxonomy (Remember, Understand, Apply, Evaluate, Create). This empowers teachers, parents, and curious readers to nurture higher-order critical thinking.

sections.heading: 2. Cultural Respect & Universal Values
sections.content: To ensure our global library remains universally welcoming to readers of all backgrounds, mythic and folkloric tales emphasize shared human wisdom, empathy, and justice.

sections.heading: 3. Ethical Translation with Human Review
sections.content: We use linguistic models to assist translation across ten languages, but we never publish unverified output. Every translation undergoes bilingual review before public release.

sections.heading: 4. Corrections and Feedback
sections.content: We maintain an active corrections policy for factual, grammatical, or translation adjustments. If you notice a typo or translation nuance that can be improved, please reach out via our contact page.

parent-guide.title: Teacher & Parent Guide
parent-guide.h1: Teacher & Parent Guide: Fostering a Love for Stories
parent-guide.metaDescription: Tips for mindful bedtime routines, reading comprehension, bilingual learning, and family story rituals.

sections.heading: The Bedtime Ritual: Calming the Senses
sections.content: Bedtime should be a transition from the bustle of the day to peaceful rest. We recommend activating our 'Night' theme which dims the screen palette, slows the read-along audio speed, and helps rest tired eyes.

sections.heading: Multilingual Reading for Growing Minds
sections.content: Compare stories across languages using our instant language switcher. This is especially loved by diaspora families, heritage language learners, and students discovering new languages.

sections.heading: Screen-Time Balance Tips
sections.content: Stories can be enjoyed screen-free! Use our audio narration with your screen dimmed or flipped over, allowing listeners to visualize the story in their minds.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.metaDescription: Our pledge to digital accessibility for all readers, including OpenDyslexic font, screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and high contrast.

sections.heading: Our Commitment
sections.content: Daily Tale is designed to be accessible to readers of all abilities, in adherence with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA standards.

sections.heading: Accessibility Features Included
sections.content:
• OpenDyslexic Font Option: Instant toggle in the Aa reading panel to aid readers with dyslexia.
• Adjustable Font Size & Line Spacing: Customize text from 16px to 25px with generous line height.
• High Contrast & Bedtime Dark Themes: Color contrast ratios exceeding 4.5:1.
• Reduced Motion Respect: Full compatibility with `prefers-reduced-motion` settings.
• Full Keyboard Navigation: Skip-to-content links and accessible focus rings.
• Screen Reader Compatibility: Semantic HTML5 elements and ARIA attributes for all interactive audio players and quizzes.

sections.heading: Reporting Barriers
sections.content: If you encounter any accessibility barrier on our website, please email support@dailystory.pages.dev. We prioritize accessibility bug fixes promptly.
